viz.readAloudUnavailable: Ukufunda ngokuvakalayo akuxhaswa ngesiXhosa. Iibhrawuza azikwazi ukuthetha isiXhosa, ngoko oku kungaphosa amagama esifundo.
viz.indexWholeNumber: I-index kufuneka ibe linani elipheleleyo, njengo-3 okanye u--1.
viz.walkingForward: Sibala ukusuka ngasekhohlo, siqala ku-0, hayi ku-1. Yile ndlela iPython enika ngayo amanani kwiimpawu. Ngoku sithathe amanyathelo angu-{steps} kwaye siphezu kophawu olungu-'{char}'.
viz.walkingForwardOne: Sibala ukusuka ngasekhohlo, siqala ku-0, hayi ku-1. Yile ndlela iPython enika ngayo amanani kwiimpawu. Sithathe inyathelo elinye kwaye siphezu kophawu olungu-'{char}'.
viz.countingBack: Sibala ukusuka ngasekunene, kuba indawo engelilo eliqinisekileyo ibala ibuyela umva. Uphawu lokugqibela ngu--1. Ngoku sifikelele ku-{steps} kwaye siphezu kophawu olungu-'{char}'.
viz.landedOn: Sime kwindawo {index}. Uphawu kwelo bhokisi ngu-'{char}'. Yiyo loo nto impendulo.
viz.ranOut: Aphelile amabhokisi. U-{index} ungaphandle koluhlu olusebenzayo.
viz.whyLanded: Nasi isizathu. Ucele text[{requested}]. Uphawu ngalunye lunamagama amabini: {pos} ukuba ubala ukusuka ekuqaleni, kunye {neg} ukuba ubala ukusuka ekupheleni. Omabini alatha kuphawu olufanayo, '{char}'. Istring ineempawu ezingu-{length}, ngoko ukubala kuqala ku-0 kwaye indawo yokugqibela ngasekhohlo ngu-{last}.
viz.indexErrorWhy: Le yi-IndexError, nto leyo ethetha ukuba le ndawo ayikho ngaphakathi kwestring. Umbhalo "{text}" uneempawu ezingu-{length}, ngoko iindawo ezivumelekileyo zisuka ku-{min} ukuya ku-{max}. Ucele u-{index}, ongekho kuluhlu. IPython ayikwazi ukunika uphawu, ngoko ibika le mpazamo endaweni yempendulo.
viz.valueErrorWhy: Le yi-ValueError. Inyathelo alinakuba ngu-0. Inyathelo elingu-0 lithetha ukungahambi napha, ngoko iPython ingaxakeka kwaye i-slice ayisoze igqibe. Yiyo loo nto ibika le mpazamo endaweni yokunika isiqwenga sestring.
viz.whyCollecting: I-slice ikopa isiqwenga sestring. Iqala kwindawo yesiqalo kwaye ithatha olo phawu. Iyeka ngaphambi kwendawo yesiphelo, ngoko uphawu lwesiphelo aluthathwa. Inyathelo lixelela ukuba kutsitywe kangakanani ngexesha ngalinye.
viz.whySliceClamped: Enye indawo oyichwethezileyo idlule isiphelo sestring. Ukusika akuwi xa kwenzeka oko. IPython iyihambisa ngokuzolileyo loo ndawo iye emaphethelweni estring ize ikope oko kushiyekileyo. Ukufikelela nge-index ngebizakuba i-IndexError.
viz.sliceWholeNumbers: Isiqalo, isiphelo kunye nenyathelo kufuneka abe ngamanani apheleleyo (okanye ushiye kungabhalwanga nto ukusebenzisa okusetiweyo).
viz.collecting: Sikopa uphawu olukwindawo {index}, olungu-'{char}'. Sitsiba nge-{step} ngexesha ngalinye.
viz.collected: Sigqibile. Sikope iimpawu ezingu-{count}, kwiindawo {indices}, ngolo landelelwano. Imveliso zezo mpawu zidityanisiweyo.
viz.collectedOne: Sigqibile. Sikope uphawu olunye, kwindawo {indices}. Olo phawu lunye yimveliso yonke.
viz.collectedNone: Sigqibile. Asikopanga nawuphi uphawu, ngoko imveliso yistring engenanto.
viz.sliceEmpty: Imveliso engenanto ayiyompazamo. I-slice ivunyelwe ukuba ingakopi nto. Ukufikelela nge-index ngekuwa ukuba indawo ayikho, kodwa ukusika akunjalo.
viz.sliceNegativeStep: Sihambo ukusuka ngasekunene ukuya ngasekhohlo kuba inyathelo lingelilo eliqinisekileyo. Oko kujika istring. Xa isiqalo nesiphelo zingabhalwanga, iPython iqala kuphawu lokugqibela ize iyeke kanye ngaphambi kwelokuqala.
viz.sliceDefault: Indawo yesiqalo iyabandakanywa ekukopeleni. Eyesiphelo ayibandakanywa. Inyathelo lixelela ukuba kutsitywe kude kangakanani phakathi kophawu ngalunye esiluthathayo.
viz.sliceIdleBefore: Shiya amabhokisi engenanto ukuze usebenzise okusetiweyo kwePython. Zama inyathelo
viz.indexIdleAfter: okanye into engaphandle koluhlu ukubona okwenzekayo.

visualiser.title: Umboniso weeString
visualiser.subtitle: Qonda indlela iistring zePython ezisebenza ngayo, kubandakanya ii-loops, iimeko, kunye nee-methods.
visualiser.descForLoop: Olu lujikelezo {n} kwe-{total} kwi-for loop. I-for loop ijonge uphawu olunye ngexesha, ukusuka ngasekhohlo ukuya ngasekunene. Ngoku i-variable c luphawu "{ch}", oluhlala kwindawo {i}. Oku kwenzeka kuba i-loop ihamba istring ngokulandelelana ize ikope uphawu ngalunye ku-c.
visualiser.descWhileTrue: Sijonga imeko ye-while {cond}. Ikhawunta i ngu-{i}, ngoko imeko yiyinyani kwaye umzimba we-loop uyaqhuba. Sijonge uphawu "{ch}" kwindawo {i}. Umzimba uyaqhuba logama olu vavanyo luhlala luyinyani.
visualiser.descWhileFalse: Sijonga kwakhona imeko ye-while {cond}. Ikhawunta i ngoku ngu-{i}, ngoko imeko ayiyonyani. Xa imeko ye-while ingeyonyani, iPython iyeka ukujikeleza. Yiyo loo nto i-loop iphela apha, kwaye akukho phawu lulandelayo.
visualiser.whileConditionUnrecognised: Le yimpazamo, hayi i-loop egqityiweyo. Lo mboniso uqonda iimeko ezifana no-i less than 5. Awuqondi "{cond}", ngoko awukwazi ukuxelela ukuba i-loop kufuneka iqhube. Yiyo loo mpazamo: imeko ayikho kwimo esi sixhobo sinokuyijonga. Zama i < 5.
visualiser.descIfTrue: Sijonga ukuba {expr}. Impendulo yiyinyani kule string, ngoko iPython iqhuba ikhowudi ephantsi kwe-if. Yiyo loo nto umzimba we-if uqhuba. Imeko iyinyani xa uvavanyo luhambelana nale string.
visualiser.descIfFalse: Sijonga ukuba {expr}. Impendulo ayiyonyani kule string, ngoko iPython iyitsiba ikhowudi ephantsi kwe-if. Ukuba kukho i-else, yiyo eza kuqhuba. Yiyo loo nto umzimba we-if ungahambi.
visualiser.descIfDone: Umzimba we-if sele uqhube, kuba imeko ibiyinyani. Akukho nto ijongekayo kweli nyathelo.
visualiser.descElseDone: Isebe le-else beliza kuqhuba apha, kuba imeko ibingeyonyani. Umzimba we-if wawutsityiwe.
visualiser.narrationIndexError: Indawo {index} ayikho ngaphakathi kwale string, ngoko iPython ibika i-IndexError.
visualiser.whyIndexPositive: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba iPython ibala ukusuka ngasekhohlo, iqala ku-0, hayi ku-1. Indawo 0 luphawu lokuqala, indawo 1 eyesibini, njalo njalo. Ngoko indawo {index} luphawu "{char}".
visualiser.whyIndexNegative: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba indawo engelilo eliqinisekileyo ibala ukusuka ngasekunene. U--1 luphawu lokugqibela, u--2 lolungaphambi kwalo. Ngoko {index} lelobhokisi linye nendawo {resolved} ukusuka ngasekhohlo, eliphethe uphawu "{char}".
visualiser.whySlice: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba i-slice iqala kwindawo {start} kwaye ibandakanya olo phawu. Iyeka ngaphambi kwendawo {stop}, ngoko olo phawu aluthathwa. Itsiba nge-{step} ngexesha ngalinye, kwaye iimpawu ezikopiweyo zidityaniswa ngolo landelelwano.
visualiser.whySliceNegative: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba inyathelo elingelilo eliqinisekileyo lihamba ukusuka ngasekunene ukuya ngasekhohlo, nto leyo ejika ulandelelwano. Iqala kwindawo {start} kwaye ibandakanya olo phawu, iyeka ngaphambi kwendawo {stop}, ize itsibe nge-{step} ngexesha ngalinye.
visualiser.whySliceEmpty: Imveliso ayinanto kuba isiqalo asikhe sihambe siye esiphelweni ngesi nyathelo, ngoko akukho nto ikopiweyo. I-slice engenanto ayiyompazamo. Ukusika kuvunyelwe ukuba kungakopi nto. Ukufikelela nge-index ngekuwa ukuba indawo ayikho.
visualiser.whySliceClamped: Indawo oyichwethezileyo idlule isiphelo sestring. Ukusika akuwi. IPython iyihambisa loo ndawo iye emaphethelweni estring ize ikope oko kushiyekileyo. Ukufikelela nge-index ngebizakuba i-IndexError.
visualiser.whyUpper: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba upper iguqula unobumba ngamnye ube ngonobumba omkhulu. Izikhewu, amanani nopawu zihlala njengoko zinjalo. Istring yoqobo ayitshintshwa. IPython ikunika istring entsha.
visualiser.whyLower: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba lower iguqula unobumba ngamnye ube ngonobumba omncinci. Izikhewu, amanani nopawu zihlala njengoko zinjalo. Istring yoqobo ayitshintshwa. IPython ikunika istring entsha.
visualiser.whyReverse: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba reverse ifunda istring ukusuka kuphawu lokugqibela ibuyele kwelokuqala. Yile ngqiqo inye ne-slice enenyathelo elingu-minus 1.
visualiser.whyStrip: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba strip isusa izikhewu kuphela ekuqaleni nasekugqibeleni. Izikhewu phakathi kwestring zihlala. Istring yoqobo ayitshintshwa.
visualiser.whyTitle: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba title yenza unobumba wokuqala wegama ngalinye ube mkhulu, kwaye intsalela yegama ngalinye ibe mincinane.
visualiser.whyLen: Loo nto yimpendulo kuba len ibala iimpawu ezikwistring, kuquka izikhewu. Elo nani alifani nendawo yokugqibela. Indawo yokugqibela ingaphantsi ngesinye kunobude, kuba ukubala kuqala ku-0.
visualiser.indexNotANumber: Le yimpazamo. "{index}" ayilonani elipheleleyo. Indawo kwistring kufuneka ibe linani elipheleleyo elifana no-0 okanye u-minus 1. IPython ayikwazi ukukhangela uphawu koku, ngoko akukho mpendulo.
visualiser.indexOutOfRange: Le yi-IndexError: indawo ingaphandle kwestring. Istring ineempawu ezingu-{length}, ngoko iindawo ezivumelekileyo zingu-{min} ukuya ku-{max}. Ucele u-{index}, ongekho kuluhlu. IPython ayikwazi ukubuyisa uphawu, ngoko ibika le mpazamo endaweni yempendulo.
visualiser.sliceZeroStep: Le yi-ValueError: inyathelo le-slice alinakuba ngu-0. Inyathelo elingu-0 lithetha ukungahambi, ngoko i-slice ayinakuze igqibe. Yiyo loo nto iPython ibika le mpazamo endaweni yokunika isiqwenga sestring.
visualiser.sliceInvalid: Le yimpazamo. "{slice}" ayisiyo i-slice esebenzayo. Isiqalo, isiphelo nenyathelo kufuneka kube linani elipheleleyo, okanye kushiywe kungenanto ukuze kusetyenziswe okusetiweyo. Ngenxa yokuba oku kungekho kwiloo mo, iPython ayikwazi ukwakha i-slice, ngoko akukho mveliso.
visualiser.methodUnsupported: Le yimpazamo. '{method}' ayiyonye kwiimethodi lo mboniso onokuzibonisa, ngoko akukho nto ibaliweyo. Zama u-upper, lower, strip, title, reverse, okanye len.
visualiser.couldNotEvaluateDetail: Le yimpazamo, hayi impendulo engelonyani. IPython ayifikelelanga nakwi-true okanye i-false. Lo mboniso awukwazanga ukuqonda "{expr}". Jonga impazamo yokuchwetheza, okanye umsebenzi olu xhobo lungawuxhasi. Ngenxa yokuba imeko ayikwazi kujongwa, i-if statement ayikwazi ukukhetha isebe.
visualiser.hintIndex: Inani elipheleleyo ukusuka ku--{min} ukuya ku-{max}
visualiser.hintWhileLoop: umz. i < 5  (u-i uqala ku-0, wonyuka nge-1)

exercise.markFailed: Le mpendulo ayikwazanga ukumakwa — iseshoni yakho isenokuba iphelelwe lixesha. Ngena kwakhona uze uzame.

masteryBlurb.proficient: Umsebenzi omhle, phucula iinkcukacha zokugqibela ezingezantsi.
masteryBlurb.developing: Isiseko sikhona. Buyela kwiimpazamo uze uzame kwakhona.
masteryBlurb.keepPractising: Buyela kwisifundo esingentla, uze uzame kwakhona.
